children: New Zealand's Westpac McDermott Miller Consumer Confidence Index increased to 89.5 in Q3 2026 from 80.4 in the previous quarter, which was its lowest level since 2023.
However, the latest reading remained in pessimism territory, amid concerns over higher fuel prices, interest rates, and living costs.

The sentiment improved but remained subdued, with lower petrol prices compared with the eye-watering highs seen earlier this year providing some relief, despite households continuing to cut back on dining out and entertainment and delaying major purchases.

title: New Zealand Q3 Consumer Mood Improves from 3-Year Low
